end.summary:
Interpreted position-time graphs as motion stories, including stopping and returning.
Identified horizontal x-t lines as zero velocity and upward slopes as positive velocity.
Connected steeper x-t slopes with greater velocity and calculated slope as 3 m/s.
Identified constant velocity on a v-t graph as a horizontal line and negative velocity as return motion.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised reading position-time and velocity-time graphs through cycling examples. Ira correctly explained stopping, positive and negative velocity, constant velocity, steepness, and calculated slope as 3 m/s. The repeated slope question caused some frustration, but the same method and answer were stated correctly again later. At home, ask Ira to describe one journey using a flat, upward, and downward graph segment.
